description:
No spec subject

Follow-up from specled_-36o (CI test job wired plain 'mix test' instead of '--cover'). Two blockers to arming the threshold gate, measured 2026-07-23 on epic branch specled_-155/aggregate-first-spec-coverage @ bef5400:

1. True full-suite coverage is 83.05% vs the configured threshold: 90 (mix.exs:10). Either raise coverage or consciously lower the threshold before wiring 'mix test --cover' into .github/workflows/specs.yml.

2. test/specled_ex/coverage/snapshot_test.exs cover-compiles tmp fixture modules (SpecLedEx.Coverage.SnapshotTestFixtures.Live*) into the host BEAM's shared :cover server and its on_exit deletes their source dirs. Under an outer 'mix test --cover' these leak into the final tally as 100% rows AND the HTML report generator crashes with {:no_source_code_found, Live*} — and the observed run EXITED 0 despite 'Coverage test failed, threshold not met', i.e. the crash masks the gate's failing exit code. Fix the leak (quarantine like decode_coverdata in specled_-aav, or unregister the modules) and confirm threshold failure exits non-zero.

When both are fixed, change the 'Run tests' step in specs.yml (native leg at least) from 'mix test --include integration' to add --cover.

comments.text: DECISION (user, 2026-07-24): arm the gate by LOWERING the threshold, not raising coverage. Change mix.exs test_coverage threshold 90 -> 83 (just below measured 83.05%). Raising coverage to 90 is explicitly out of scope; a ratchet follow-up will be filed separately. Both ticket blockers still apply: fix the snapshot fixture-module cover leak (quarantine like decode_coverdata in specled_-aav, or unregister modules) and confirm threshold failure exits non-zero, then add --cover to the native 'Run tests' step in .github/workflows/specs.yml.

CONTRACT (orchestrator-synthesized)

Allowed touches:
- mix.exs (test_coverage threshold 90 -> 83 only)
- .github/workflows/specs.yml (add --cover to the native 'Run tests' step)
- test/specled_ex/coverage/snapshot_test.exs
- test/support/**
- .spec/specs/** ONLY if the spec gate demands subject co-change for touched files
- .spec/state.json, .spec/realization_hashes.json (tool-managed baselines; regenerate via documented command only, never hand-edit)

Out of Scope (files): lib/**, all other workflows/steps, CHANGELOG, VERSION.

Out of Scope (intent): no new deps; no writing new tests to raise coverage (threshold decision is 83, not 90); no ratchet mechanism; no refactors beyond the leak fix; do not touch the container leg of specs.yml beyond what the ticket names (native leg at least).

Verification:
1. Targeted: mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/snapshot_test.exs green.
2. Leak proof: under an outer `mix test --cover`, no SpecLedEx.Coverage.SnapshotTestFixtures.Live* rows appear in the coverage tally and the HTML/report generation does not crash with {:no_source_code_found, ...}.
3. Exit-code proof: demonstrate that a threshold failure exits non-zero (e.g. one run with threshold temporarily above measured coverage), and record the command + observed exit code in the completion record.
4. FULL-SUITE EXCEPTION (explicitly authorized for this ticket only): one final `mix test --include integration --cover` run must be green with threshold 83 — the deliverable IS suite-level coverage behavior, so the change-scoped-only rule is waived for this single proof run.
5. mix spec.check --no-run-commands green.

IMPLEMENTED
Session: 45487a8d-2b6e-4948-8a5e-8ce33f9f30f1
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-remembers/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/45487a8d-2b6e-4948-8a5e-8ce33f9f30f1.jsonl

Commit: ba92346 (+ cc5a98a, empty commit fixing a malformed Spec-Drift trailer)
Files touched: mix.exs, .github/workflows/specs.yml, test/specled_ex/coverage/snapshot_test.exs, .spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md, .spec/specs/package.spec.md, .spec/specs/compiler_tracer.spec.md
Tests added: none new — rewrote snapshot_test.exs's private fixture helper (with_cover_compiled_module/0 -> cover_snapshot_in_child/1); the 3 tests that cover-compile a fixture (native_snapshot read, native idempotency, classic_snapshot read) plus the native/classic parity test now run their compile+cover-compile+exercise+read cycle in a child `elixir -e` process via ERL_LIBS, never the host's :cover server. Assertions unchanged.
Verification stubs flipped: none
Verification tier: change-scoped + authorized full-suite --cover proof.
  - mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/snapshot_test.exs --include integration: 13/13 green.
  - mix test --include integration --cover: 1153 tests/3 properties, 0 failures, exit 0, Total 83.21% (>= threshold 83), no SnapshotTestFixtures.Live* rows, no {:no_source_code_found, _} crash. Ran twice (pre- and post-commit) plus once more after the spec co-updates -- all green, same 83.21%.
  - Exit-code proof: mix.exs threshold temporarily set to 99, ran mix test --include integration --cover -> exit 3, "Coverage test failed, threshold not met: Coverage 83.21% / Threshold 99.00%". Threshold reverted to 83 immediately after (confirmed via git diff before commit).
  - mix compile --warnings-as-errors: exit 0. mix format --check-formatted: exit 0.
  - mix spec.check --no-run-commands --base 2e6f3d4103a75149b45b72bb5c9557fd4fe240f3: exit 0 (branch_guard_missing_decision_update resolved via Spec-Drift trailer in commit cc5a98a; two branch_guard_missing_subject_update findings on mix.exs/snapshot_test.exs resolved by co-updating package.spec.md, compiler_tracer.spec.md (incidental-touch clarification prose) and coverage_capture.spec.md (real co-update documenting the child-BEAM quarantine discipline, mirroring specled_-aav's decode_coverdata note)).
Final-tier runs: 2 (finals_gt1 — first full --cover proof ran clean before the .spec/specs co-updates; re-ran after adding those co-updates + the trailer-fix commit to confirm nothing regressed, still clean).
Deferred must requirements: none.

Summary: Fixed the snapshot_test.exs cover-compiled fixture-module leak by quarantining the whole fixture compile/cover-compile/exercise/read cycle in a separate `elixir -e` child process (own :cover coordinator), so it can never register in the host's :cover server the way it did before (which caused spurious 100% Live* rows and a {:no_source_code_found} HTML-report crash under an outer `mix test --cover`). Lowered mix.exs's test_coverage threshold from 90 to 83 per the recorded decision (measured true coverage 83.05%), and armed `.github/workflows/specs.yml`'s native "Run tests" step with `--cover`. Proved both the happy path (green, 83.21%, no leak, exit 0) and the failure path (temporarily-raised threshold exits non-zero) under the full authorized `--include integration --cover` suite run.

title: Arm mix test --cover in CI: close 83.05%→90% coverage gap and fix snapshot fixture-module cover leak
